mapper.insert: insert into miniprograme.clubs (club_name, teacher, description, maxStudents, grade,deadline, position, category, admission_semester) values ( #{club.clubName}, #{club.teacher}, #{club.description}, #{club.maxStudents}, #{club.grade}, #{club.deadline}, #{club.position}, #{club.category}, #{club.admissionSemester} )
mapper.delete: delete from miniprograme.clubs where (club_name = #{club.clubName} and grade = #{club.grade} and admission_semester = #{club.admissionSemester})
